visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown wavy hair and black sunglasses stands outdoors talking to the camera. A man in yellow and orange robes stands behind her near a white wall and green sign. (2) A young girl in a checkered dress walks toward a cafe named 'ICE HUB' which has green plants and mango decorations outside. (3) The camera pans across a glass window covered in colorful caricature drawings of families, couples, and pets. (4) Indoors, a diverse group of people including a young couple, children, and an elderly couple pose with wide smiles while hugging or leaning against each other. (5) A bowl of bright yellow mango shaved ice is presented; a wooden spoon pours black tapioca pearls over the top. A young boy takes a large bite with a smile. (6) A hand wearing a red and black glove uses a black marker to quickly sketch a caricature on white paper under a bright desk lamp. (7) Multiple people hold up their finished caricature portraits, which feature exaggerated facial features and vibrant colors, reacting with laughter and surprise. (8) The man in yellow robes holds his portrait outside against a backdrop of trees and street traffic, smiling broadly.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat electronic pop music with a female vocal begins. A female narrator speaks with high energy and clarity over the music, accompanied by faint outdoor city ambience. (2) A bright 'ding' sound effect marks a transition. The music continues with a steady 4/4 beat. (3) Rapid camera shutter sounds sync with quick visual cuts showing different people posing. The narrator's tone remains cheerful and informative. (4) A splashing/pouring sound effect is clearly audible as syrup is poured onto shaved ice, followed by the sound of a crunch as a child eats. (5) Fast scratching sounds of a marker on paper dominate the mix for several seconds, simulating the speed of the artist. (6) The audio swells with multiple voices laughing, cheering, and saying 'Wow' in high-arousal tones as the portraits are revealed. The background music reaches a final peak and ends with a sharp cut.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and recommend a unique family experience in Chiang Mai involving custom caricatures and mango shaved ice at ICE HUB.
